title: Farmacies Cultivating Sustainable Agriculture Costa Dia Grària
reason: Describes agricultural practices and initiatives in an agreement between farmacies and the government of Mallorca.

tasks.task: Explain the first block of actions to improve soy fertility.

subtasks.text: Discuss the base of soy productivity and its economic implications for pharmacies.
Mention the analysis and management recommendations for soy productivity.
Explain the support provided to pharmacies in implementing new practices and necessary materials.

tasks.task: Describe the second block of actions to improve water management practices.

subtasks.text: Recommend reducing the extraction of fresh water from the aquifer.
Describe maintaining humidity in soy to improve fertility.
Explain the removal of waste water systems that are not well-maintained or abandoned.

tasks.task: Outline the third block of actions for biodiversity conservation.

subtasks.text: Highlight the inventory of each pharmacy that helps detect areas for protection.
Emphasize collaboration in habitat maintenance and restoration.
Mention the preservation of olive groves and their traditional methods.
